name: pause-freezes-position
description: Pressing the play control while running pauses the core, and the position genuinely stops advancing.

steps.name: positionIncreasing
steps.note: Pausing something that was never running proves nothing, so the position is confirmed moving before the press. The dialog opens playing (mpv brings a fresh file up playing), so there is no preliminary press here.

steps.name: positionFrozen
steps.note: The real assertion of a pause: unchanged within 0.05s over a 400ms window. A sleep would only prove the clock ran, not that the position held - this is the bounded observation the contract asks for instead.

assertions.note: A pause holds the position it paused at; a seek-to-zero or a stall would satisfy positionFrozen on a time-pos of 0.
Guarantees the pause was announced through the surface's own signal rather than the core's flag being set behind the shell's back.
